race.description: North United Wolves Football Club Mdn Plate
race.comment: MIDNIGHT CHARTER (3) is a Zoustar first starter from the Bjorn Baker yard. Has had six trials this calendar year, the latest a huge win at Warwick Farm. Half-brother to Group 1 placegetter Biscayne Bay and Group 2 winner Tenley. Has all the right ingredients for a successful debut. VOLCANIC ACTIVITY (11) did a good job on debut 16 days ago over this course and distance, racing handy then working home well to finish runner-up. Draws a better gate this time and with some natural improvement can go one better. HOME AND DRY (7) disappointed as a $2.10 chance on debut at Kembla last start. Blinkers go on today so she deserves another chance. YOSHIDA (2) is back after a 108-day spell. Opened last prep with a close second on debut at Canterbury - big chance with a repeat of that effort.
